purpose: Lock the single active Layer-B v2 slot to the NPS NCRN forest-bird system only after public-documentation prescreening established a plausible path through transport, geometry, response semantics and partition-level both-class estimability without opening biological response bytes.

source.title: National Capital Region Network Forest and Grassland Bird Monitoring Data Package - cumulative through 2025

stage0_allowed_resources.name: ncrn_birds_forest_points.csv
stage0_allowed_resources.role: response-independent forest monitoring location registry and latitude/longitude

stage0_allowed_resources.name: ncrn_birds_forest_visits.csv
stage0_allowed_resources.role: response-independent survey-visit calendar/effort and observation opportunity

focal_target.positive: at least one documented Red-bellied Woodpecker detection during eligible forest bird surveys in that site-year
focal_target.negative: eligible forest monitoring site-year with survey opportunity but no Red-bellied Woodpecker detection

independent_estimability_certificate_bas.publication: Redmond 2023, Long-term landbird monitoring in the National Capital Region National Parks, University of Delaware MS thesis
independent_estimability_certificate_bas.derivation: Across every year in the 13-year study, detected-site count lies in [123,205]; with 277 forest plots, positives are therefore >=123 and nondetected sites >=277-205=72 in each year.

prospective_nested_partition.pre_response_reason: All three chronological partitions lie inside the independently analyzed 2007-2019 period, for which annual detected-site counts imply both-class support far above the frozen minima in every constituent year.

stage0_terminal_failures: any allowed individual NPS resource cannot be transported reproducibly under its frozen DownloadFile ID and Reference
metadata XML does not independently define the response entity, join keys, or missing/absence semantics strongly enough to derive site-year detection from counts plus visits
forest points do not reproduce at least 50 unique station-level latitude/longitude coordinates
forest visits do not cover all frozen years 2007-2019 or do not independently define eligible survey opportunity
resource identities or schema contradict the frozen target grain or partition
